launch_blockers: baseline_summary is UNMEASURED; record the preceding 7-day attributable ServGo lead/demo figures before launch
notes: Thresholds below are deliberate test design, not historical facts. No baseline or performance data has been measured.

experiment.name: Founder outreach to Sochi massage/spa businesses
experiment.hypothesis: Personalized founder outreach to a bounded cohort of 20 Sochi massage/spa and small service businesses with manual or fragmented booking produces at least 2 qualified ServGo leads within 7 days.
experiment.audience: Owners/managers of massage studios, spas and small service businesses in Sochi that take bookings manually or through fragmented channels.
experiment.action: Manually select 20 relevant businesses and send one personalized, non-spam outreach message with a ServGo demo/landing link. No bulk automation. One follow-up maximum when appropriate.
experiment.attribution_method: Unique campaign UTM plus per-lead identifier where practical, and mandatory manual source field for each lead. Campaign: servgo_exp_001.
experiment.baseline_summary: UNMEASURED — record the immediately preceding 7-day attributable ServGo lead/demo figures before launch. Do not substitute zero unless verified.
experiment.success_condition: KEEP if at least 2 qualified leads are attributable to EXP-SERVGO-001 after all 20 targeted contacts and the 7-day observation window.
experiment.stop_condition: STOP if all 20 targeted contacts were completed with valid attribution, the 7-day window elapsed, and 0 qualified leads were attributable to the experiment.
experiment.inconclusive_condition: INCONCLUSIVE if fewer than 20 contacts were completed, attribution is incomplete, the observation window has not elapsed, or the baseline was not recorded before launch.

qualified_lead_definition: A business owner/manager who replies with concrete interest in evaluating ServGo, asks for a demo/price/setup details, or agrees to a follow-up conversation. A generic acknowledgement is not a qualified lead.
constraints: Organic/free acquisition only; no paid ads.
No bulk automation, scraping, or automated sending.
Each outreach message is written and sent manually by the founder.
